metadata.description: Hierarchical product brick map for the transfer-pricing-compliance-platform domain, modeled on Reptune and its Reptune.net SaaS platform: the transfer pricing data model and data intake, automated Master File and Local File generation with localisation and translation, Country-by-Country Reporting and benchmarks, the compliance workflow and dashboard, the Legal Module, AI assistance, and the platform foundation of identity, organisations, audit, rendering, security and full-service delivery.

bricks.name: Transfer Pricing Model, Company Types and Functional Analyses
bricks.description: The intelligent transfer pricing data model that Reptune has developed since 2015 and the strategic asset behind Reptune.net: company types (for example limited-risk distributor, contract manufacturer, principal, service provider), functional analyses, transfer pricing methods and policies are configured once and then applied across every entity, transaction and report. The model is what lets Local Files, Master Files and CbCR be generated without manual changes to the exported files, and it is what the R-AI onboarding assistant helps a new client fill in during the free two-week trial. Every other brick keys on the model identifiers it publishes.
